caseName: Hart ex rel. Hart v. Community School Board
caseNameFull: Hart, a minor, by Hart v. Community School Board of Brooklyn, New York, School District 21

opinions.text: Application to vacate order of the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit and to reinstate judgment of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York, presented to Mr. Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
